## Who We Are

Kubota uses a wide range of products and technologies to provide solutions in the areas of food,
water, and the environment, which are indispensable for people's lives. From a grain of rice or a
drop of water to the foundations of society and industry, Kubota's solutions support the lives of
human beings.
* ### [Agriculture][170]
  
  As a comprehensive solutions provider for agriculture, Kubota offers total support at every stage
  of farming, from developing agricultural machinery that meets farmers' needs to the production,
  processing and consumption of agricultural products. Kubota supports farming throughout the world
  and contributes to a more prosperous future for people and food.
  
  [
  ][171]
* ### [Water][172]
  
  Kubota's water environment solutions are active in all aspects of the water cycle, supporting
  water infrastructure in Japan and throughout the world. As a water treatment specialist, we are
  committed to finding solutions to the world's water problems and supplying safe water to all
  people in the world.
  
  [
  ][173]
* ### [Environment][174]
  
  Social infrastructure is indispensable for our prosperous and comfortable lives. Industrial
  infrastructure serves as the foundation for manufacturing. Kubota answers the needs of society to
  offer solutions that support these infrastructures, contributing to more affluent lives for
  humans.
  
  [
  ][175]

[Groundwork for Tomorrow][176]

## Innovation

Kubota envisions the social issues that could arise in the near future and creates new services and
business and develops products in anticipation if these issues, contributing even further to
society.

[Learn More][177]

## Sustainability

Kubota considers food, water and the environment as a singular theme, and aims to realize a
sustainable society through a proper cycle of these elements using technology and solutions.

[Learn More][178]

## Who We Are

Kubota uses a wide range of products and technologies to provide solutions in the areas of food,
water, and the environment, which are indispensable for people's lives. From a grain of rice or a
drop of water to the foundations of society and industry, Kubota's solutions support the lives of
human beings.
* ### [Agriculture][170]
  
  As a comprehensive solutions provider for agriculture, Kubota offers total support at every stage
  of farming, from developing agricultural machinery that meets farmers' needs to the production,
  processing and consumption of agricultural products. Kubota supports farming throughout the world
  and contributes to a more prosperous future for people and food.
  
  [
  ][171]
* ### [Water][172]
  
  Kubota's water environment solutions are active in all aspects of the water cycle, supporting
  water infrastructure in Japan and throughout the world. As a water treatment specialist, we are
  committed to finding solutions to the world's water problems and supplying safe water to all
  people in the world.
  
  [
  ][173]
* ### [Environment][174]
  
  Social infrastructure is indispensable for our prosperous and comfortable lives. Industrial
  infrastructure serves as the foundation for manufacturing. Kubota answers the needs of society to
  offer solutions that support these infrastructures, contributing to more affluent lives for
  humans.
  
  [
  ][175]

[Groundwork for Tomorrow][176]

## Innovation

Kubota envisions the social issues that could arise in the near future and creates new services and
business and develops products in anticipation if these issues, contributing even further to
society.

[Learn More][177]

## Sustainability

Kubota considers food, water and the environment as a singular theme, and aims to realize a
sustainable society through a proper cycle of these elements using technology and solutions.

## **High‑Performance Gas Filtration with Lower CAPEX**

 

Pall’s High Flow Gas solution delivers reliable particulate removal for large‑volume gas streams
while helping operators lower upfront CAPEX. Smaller vessels and fewer elements reduce footprint and

## A Trusted Partner of Life Science Research and the Biopharmaceutical Industry


We are living in the bio-century. Global medical knowledge is expanding at a rapid pace. But despite
huge breakthroughs, many diseases, such as cancer, rheumatism or Alzheimer's, are still not
curable.  Sartorius is part of the solution.

We help to ensure that new scientific discoveries can be translated more quickly into effective
patient care. With technologies, platforms and partnerships for a common goal: better health for
more people.

* 26/05/2026 Oil&Gas
  [
  
  #### A New Repair & Maintenance Workshop, Strengthening Actemium’s Long-term Presence in
  #### Mauritania
  
  ][25]
  On April 2, Actemium Oil & Gas Mauritania inaugurated its new maintenance workshop located at
  the heart of the Port Autonome de Nouakchott, Mauritania.
  [Read more][26]
* 08/04/2026 A Green Transition in Industry
  [
  
  #### Actemium Engineers’ Adventures at Sea: Providing Support on a Ship with a Clean-Energy
  #### Mission
  
  ][27]
  Every facet of Actemium's strategy relies on finding very talented people. Bringing in the best
  engineers takes more than simply paying well, so it helps to have uniquely challenging projects
  that appeal to those with a strong sense of adventure.
  [Read more][28]
* 25/03/2026 Maintenance
  [
  
  #### Actemium Signs Full Maintenance Contract with TOPAS Advanced Polymers GmbH
  
  ][29]
  Actemium has signed a comprehensive three-year full maintenance contract with TOPAS Advanced
  Polymers GmbH for the company’s new production plant at the Leuna Chemical Park.
  [Read more][30]
* 16/03/2026 Aerospace
  [
  
  #### Actemium transforms passenger transit at a major UK airport with smarter systems monitoring
  
  ][31]
  Drawing on over 30 years of experience delivering safety critical automation systems for national
  infrastructure, Actemium has implemented a modern monitoring panel solution that provides real
  time asset insight, supports predictive maintenance, and offers an upgrade ready architecture –
  all without disrupting passenger moving operations.
  [Read more][32]
* 25/02/2026 A Green Transition in Industry
  [
  
  #### Actemium at the Heart of the Cerisea Bio-Based Industrial Demonstrator
  
  ][33]
  Led by ResiCare, an entity of the Michelin Engineered Polymers division dedicated to green
  chemistry solutions, the Cerisea project paves the way for a new generation of bio-based 5-HMF
  resins
  [Read more][34]
* 23/02/2026
  [
  
  #### Actemium supports RWE in structural transformation
  
  ][35]
  As part of the construction of two sewage sludge mono-incineration plants, Actemium Materials
  Handling Cologne is supplying electrical and control systems for the ancillary trades.
  [Read more][36]
* 17/02/2026
  [
  
  #### Actemium Delivers Advanced Security Systems for Three New Stockholm Metro Stations
  
  ][37]
  As the metro network in Stockholm undergoes a major modernization and expansion program on behalf
  of Region Stockholm, new infrastructure must meet the highest technical and security
  standards—both today and in the decades to come. In this strategic context, Actemium has been
  entrusted by Sice Nordics AB to deliver and commission advanced security systems for three new
  Green Line stations: Hagastaden, Södra Hagalund and Arenastaden.
  [Read more][38]
* 02/02/2026 Logistics
  [
  
  #### Actemium Lyon Logistics supports GLS France in automating its new national HUB
  
  ][39]
  As part of accelerating its development and modernizing its delivery and transport network, GLS
  France has chosen Actemium to automate its new national HUB, covering an area of 12,000 m² and
  located in Coudray-Montceaux (Essonne).
  [Read more][40]
* 21/01/2026
  [
  
  #### Optimization Starts at Home: Actemium Units Work Together to Streamline Schematics Versioning
  
  ][41]
  Actemium Netherlands helps its clients become more efficient by designing, building, optimizing
  and maintaining industrial processes in a wide variety of industries — from food to green energy,
  to tire manufacturing. The company is proud of its reputation for agility, flexibility, and
  innovation.
  [Read more][42]
* 18/12/2025
  [
  
  #### Modernizing the Djeno Oil Terminal for a Cleaner and Safer Process
  
  ][43]
  Actemium Congo is supporting TotalEnergies in a major modernization project at the Djeno oil
  terminal, a strategic asset that represents 97% of the Republic of the Congo’s national oil
  production.
  [Read more][44]

# International Biotech
# Consultation and Execution

Illuminating biotech from therapeutic concept to market. Complete regulatory, QA, and CMC consulting
services for pharmaceutical and medical device companies
[Ask us Anything - Schedule your Free Consultation ][49] [Give us a call ][50]

## About us

At the intersection of innovation and regulation
ADRES’ team of consultants guide startups and established companies as they navigate complex medical
regulatory environments. From novel medical devices to new biopharma creations and technologies,
ADRES has the experience and relationships to help secure regulatory approval in the United States,
Europe, Israel, and globally.

ADRES clients operate in multiple fields, in the pursuit of treatments for an array of medical
conditions. They include vaccines, biologicals, cell therapies and ATMPs, botanical drugs,
liposomes, and medical devices. Our clients are located around the globe, including Israel, USA,
Europe, Brazil, India, and China.
Our European subsidiary ADRES EU B.V. is located in Amsterdam, The Netherlands. Holding SME status,
ADRES EU includes other small companies, enabling access to a variety of regulatory benefits ( e.g.
considerably reduced fees when approaching a scientific advice meeting with the European Medicines
Agency – EMA).

ADRES EU also serves as the European Representative during the conduct of clinical trials for
pharmaceuticals and medical devices, as well as the European Representative for CE-marked medical
devices.

Service for Every Vertical
Startups
ADRES is your end-to-end guide at every stage of development. We will serve as part of your
development team, getting to know your product and technology in depth. We will help you resolve any
challenges along the way as we move through the process.
Big Pharma
ADRES can seamlessly integrate into your team whenever you are short on personnel. We can also
perform internal and external audits, as well as serve as an outlet to various regulatory bodies.
VC
ADRES offers impartial guidance during due diligence before any investment. We analyze companies and
recommend business strategies, optimizing a portfolio company’s likelihood for success.
Academic Institutions
ADRES works with training programs, serving as a mentor or guide on projects. In addition, ADRES
supports TTOs (tech transfer offices) in project evaluation, defining regulatory strategy, and
building the company’s foundation before embarking into the world of development.

Early Stage

ADRES’s mission at this stage is to protect companies from delays while staying within budget. We
help our clients prioritize and focus on the steps needed to creatively turn their vision into
reality.

Pre-clinical

design preclinical studies to ensure you are set up with relevant safety data, and consider animal
welfare, including interacting with global regulatory author

### We are creative problem solvers

At Alpha Bio, our mission is to act as a catalyst for biotech and pharmaceutical manufacturers,
navigating through legacy challenges and complexities to expedite the introduction of life changing
products to market. We’re committed to leveraging our expertise and innovative solutions to empower
our partners in producing high-quality, cost-effective, and compliant pharmaceuticals and biotech
products.

Established in 1986, Alpha Bio has solidified its position as a global leader in providing scalable
equipment and services for the biotech and pharmaceutical manufacturing industries. Our extensive
expertise includes but is not limited to – system integration for unit operations (as well as
computer systems integration and HMI builds), system design and engineering, customized buffer and
media management solutions, single-use kits, retrofitting unit process optimization, custom software
development, programming, quality control and inspection services.

Alpha Bio has emerged as the preferred partner for entities seeking efficient, compliant, and
cost-effective solutions to expedite their product development and market entry.

The Manufacturability Gap

# The science is ready.
# The equipment usually isn't.

That's the problem Alphinity was built to solve.

New therapies are failing in manufacturing, not in the lab. Fragile modalities. Viscous
formulations. Unstable TMP. Scale-up failure. Alphinity designs the fluid handling systems that
solve these problems at the source.

[Meet TFFi™. Our single-use TFF system][24] [Join our Prove-It campaign][25]
[ [INTERPHEX 2026 Best Technologies Innovation Award] ][26]

**Enabling Abundance in Medicine**™. Precision fluid handling for the therapies that matter most.

Process-First Engineering

## Your process.
## Our starting point.

Every piece of Alphinity equipment is designed around a specific process challenge. Four territories
where conventional fluid handling consistently fails, and where our technology makes the difference.

01

### Fragile Modalities

Viral vectors, cell therapies, exosomes, LNPs. Standard processing loses 20 to 40% of AAV titer to
mechanical damage. Our single-use diaphragm pump eliminates the root cause: positive displacement
with no product contact with moving parts.

02

### Viscous Formulations

High-concentration mAbs, dense biologics, viscous buffers, and intensified processes. Conventional
pumping technologies cannot maintain reliable flow above ~500 cP. Our diaphragm pump handles up to
3,000 cP with flow rate independent of viscosity and backpressure.

03

### Process Control

Unstable transmembrane pressure leads to membrane fouling, inconsistent flux, and failed batches.
Near-pulseless diaphragm pumping combined with our electric diaphragm valve delivers the
precision-controlled flow that sensitive processes demand.

04

### Scale-Up Failure

Processes that work at bench scale fail in manufacturing because the mechanical conditions change
with scale. Alphinity's platform maintains identical flow behavior from 30 mL screening to 10 L
clinical batches. No process redesign.

Solutions by modality

## Equipment that matches the modality.

The same TFF skid that works for monoclonal antibodies will tear apart a viral vector. Alphinity
equipment is engineered around the modality being made, not the modality biopharma made twenty years
ago.

TFF that preserves capsid integrity. Pump architecture that does not shear what it carries.
Single-use end to end.

stability window mRNA actually has.

Read more ›

Read more ›

### Cell & gene therapy

Small-batch, closed-system compatible, autologous-friendly. Built for the scales gene therapy
actually runs at.

### Proteins & mAbs

Single-use TFF, low-shear pumping, and process equipment for recombinant proteins and monoclonal
antibodies at every scale.

Read more ›

### Plasmid DNA

Upstream of viral vector and mRNA. TFF and filtration for GMP plasmid production at the scale and

Each product solves a specific manufacturing problem. They work independently, and together as an

The Fundamentals Hub

## The engineering behind the equipment.

Process science from the Alphinity engineering team. Plain English explanations of why fluid
handling matters as much as the molecule it carries, organized by the three areas where the
questions keep coming back.

[
Pump Science

### How a pump moves fluid, and what it does to the molecule on the way through.

Positive displacement, peristaltic, and centrifugal designs. Shear, cavitation, pulsation,
viscosity, and scale-up. The discipline behind why two pumps rated for the same flow rate can do
very different things to your product.

Explore pump science ›
][38] [
Valve Engineering

### How a valve controls flow and keeps a process closed.

Diaphragm, pinch, and check designs, across single-use and stainless multi-use. Hold-up volume, dead
leg, actuation, and closure dynamics. The discipline behind clean, closed, controlled transitions
between unit operations.

Explore valve engineering ›
][39] [
TFF Science

### How a TFF system concentrates the molecule without compromising it.

Transmembrane pressure, concentration polarization, flux decline, gel layer dynamics, and skid
architecture. The discipline behind concentration and diafiltration that protects the molecule, not
just retains it.

Explore TFF science ›
][40]
[Browse the Fundamentals hub][41]

Bespoke Systems

## Built around your process.
## Not the other way around.

The Manufacturability Gap

# The science is ready.
# The equipment usually isn't.

That's the problem Alphinity was built to solve.

New therapies are failing in manufacturing, not in the lab. Fragile modalities. Viscous
formulations. Unstable TMP. Scale-up failure. Alphinity designs the fluid handling systems that
solve these problems at the source.

[Meet TFFi™. Our single-use TFF system][24] [Join our Prove-It campaign][25]
[ [INTERPHEX 2026 Best Technologies Innovation Award] ][26]

**Enabling Abundance in Medicine**™. Precision fluid handling for the therapies that matter most.

Process-First Engineering

## Your process.
## Our starting point.

Every piece of Alphinity equipment is designed around a specific process challenge. Four territories
where conventional fluid handling consistently fails, and where our technology makes the difference.

01

### Fragile Modalities

Viral vectors, cell therapies, exosomes, LNPs. Standard processing loses 20 to 40% of AAV titer to
mechanical damage. Our single-use diaphragm pump eliminates the root cause: positive displacement
with no product contact with moving parts.

02

### Viscous Formulations

High-concentration mAbs, dense biologics, viscous buffers, and intensified processes. Conventional
pumping technologies cannot maintain reliable flow above ~500 cP. Our diaphragm pump handles up to
3,000 cP with flow rate independent of viscosity and backpressure.

03

### Process Control

Unstable transmembrane pressure leads to membrane fouling, inconsistent flux, and failed batches.
Near-pulseless diaphragm pumping combined with our electric diaphragm valve delivers the
precision-controlled flow that sensitive processes demand.

04

### Scale-Up Failure

Processes that work at bench scale fail in manufacturing because the mechanical conditions change
with scale. Alphinity's platform maintains identical flow behavior from 30 mL screening to 10 L
clinical batches. No process redesign.

Solutions by modality

## Equipment that matches the modality.

The same TFF skid that works for monoclonal antibodies will tear apart a viral vector. Alphinity
equipment is engineered around the modality being made, not the modality biopharma made twenty years
ago.

TFF that preserves capsid integrity. Pump architecture that does not shear what it carries.
Single-use end to end.

Sterile filtration, concentration, and buffer exchange engineered around the chemistry and the
stability window mRNA actually has.

### Lipid nanoparticles

Concentration and TFF without compromising the lipid bilayer. Shear and pulsation managed at the
architecture level.

Read more ›

[CAR-T cell render with engineered receptor detail]

### Cell & gene therapy

Small-batch, closed-system compatible, autologous-friendly. Built for the scales gene therapy
actually runs at.

Read more ›
][30] [
[IgG monoclonal antibody Y-structure render]

### Proteins & mAbs

Single-use TFF, low-shear pumping, and process equipment for recombinant proteins and monoclonal
antibodies at every scale.

Read more ›

### Plasmid DNA

Upstream of viral vector and mRNA. TFF and filtration for GMP plasmid production at the scale and

viscosity, and scale-up. The discipline behind why two pumps rated for the same flow rate can do
very different things to your product.

between unit operations.

TFF Science

architecture. The discipline behind concentration and diafiltration that protects the molecule, not
just retains it.

# Amerigo Scientific

[Media]

## Ion Exchange Resins

Amerigo Scientific offers high-quality adsorbent resins, catalyst resins, chelating resins, and
other ion exchange resins for many industries, such as chemical processing, hydrometallurgy, water
treatment, biopharmaceuticals, and food & beverage processing.

[Learn More][206]
Food & Beverage Processing
Biopharmaceuticals & Life Science
Chemical Processing
Civil & Industry Water Treatment
[Learn More][207]

## Monodisperse Chromatographic Media

Amerigo Scientific offers a wide range of high-quality monodisperse chromatographic media with
diverse materials, diameters, and pore sizes. Manufactured in ISO-9001 certified facilities using
world-leading technologies, these media are specifically designed for the purification of proteins,
enzymes, antibodies, viruses, oligonucleotides, and other substances.

[Learn More][208]

## Valpha® Virus Removal Filters

Amerigo Scientific provides Valpha® virus removal filters for efficiently removing virus particles
from biological products such as plasma products, antibodies, and proteins.

•  Three types of Valpha® membrane (RC, RC HP, and PES) available
•  Virus safety LRV (Log Reduction Value) >4 logs
•  A complete verification and quality system for manufacturing
•  Type II DMF filed with the FDA

[Learn More][209]

## Proteonano™ UltraPlex Proteomics Platform

Amerigo Scientific offers proprietary technology-based automated and standardized platform

## About Us

Great Ultrafiltration Systems, Take Challenge IM
Pioneer of full-automatic ultrafiltration system
Challenge IM focuses on developing, manufacturing, selling, and servicing membrane filtration
systems for the biopharmaceutical industry. It has diversified its product lines to support
laboratory, pilot, and large-scale production, offering commercial and customized solutions that
meet customer and market needs. Its fully automated, unattended tangential flow filtration system
fills a significant gap in both domestic and international markets, driving global technological
innovation. These products are now widely used across various biopharmaceutical sectors, including
antibodies, vaccines, nucleic acid drugs, cell therapy, and gene therapy.

## How We Work - Leading Industrial Pleated Filter Cartridge Manufacturer

**Step 1: Inquiry & Consultation**

Send us your requirements (flow rate, micron rating, application, quantity, packaging needs). Our
sales engineers will provide tailored recommendations.

**Step 2: Quotation & Sampling**

You’ll receive a detailed quotation and free sample support if needed for testing and approval.

**Step 3: Order Confirmation & Production**

After receiving your PO and deposit, we start production under strict quality protocols.

**Step 4: Quality Inspection**

Every batch is inspected by QC, including integrity testing, dimensional checks, and pressure drop
tests.

**Step 5: Fast Delivery **

We arrange fast shipping via sea, air, or courier. Ongoing technical support and reordering services
are provided.

**Step 5: After-Sales**

Our engineers assist clients with filtration system design, troubleshooting, and performance
optimization worldwide.

## FAQ – Frequently Asked Questions

What types of industrial filter cartridges do you manufacture?

We manufacture a wide range of industrial filter cartridges including pleated filter cartridges,
depth filter cartridges, and membrane filter cartridges. Each type is designed for specific
applications, ensuring high filtration efficiency and durability for industrial use.

What materials are your pleated filter cartridges made of?

Our pelated filter cartridges are made from high-quality polypropylene (PP), polyester, and PTFE
materials. These materials ensure chemical resistance, temperature stability, and long service life
for industrial filtration systems.

Do you provide pleated, string-wound, and melt-blown filter cartridges?

Yes, we offer pleated filter cartridges for high dirt-holding capacity, string-wound cartridges for
depth filtration, and melt-blown cartridges for precision filtration. All types are suitable for

Adherent Cell and Derivatives Specialists

# Esco Healthcare
# Product Portfolio

The Esco Healthcare has a wide range of bioprocess solutions from adherent bioreactors, stirred tank
bioreactors, consumables, cell-line specific culture medium, and more. Bioprocess manufacturing
includes several key components to improve product yield. As part of the bioprocess equipment
manufacturers worldwide, our systems are perfect for research and development up to commercial or
manufacturing scale.

CelCradle

CelCradle is a bench-scale bioreactor system that can support high adherent cell density culture. It
is a single-use, cost effective packed-bed bioreactor system for adherent scale-up from laboratory
scale to production scale. This disposable bioreactor fits inside a 6ft³ CO2 incubator (for batch
culture) or 8.5ft³ CO2 incubator (for perfusion culture).

The ready-to-use bottles, as part of single-use manufacturing, helps eliminate validation costs as
compared to multiple-use system when starting on your next cell culture run. The system components
come pre-sterilized, pre-packed that speed up your research whether for vaccine, stem cell, or viral
production applications.

[Learn More ][9]
[CelCradle]

TideXcell

TideXcell^{®} is a linearly scalable pilot bioreactor system that runs on Tide Motion principle. It
is ideal for biomass expansion of adherent cells under single-use or multiple-use technologies. The
pilot scale bioreactor is also integrated with desirable and advanced features such as pH and DO
(Dissolved Oxygen) measurement capability, Siemens HMI or PLC-based monitoring and control system,
compressed air path that comes with a double HEPA and VOC (volatile organic chemicals) filters as
well as other accessories.
[Learn More ][10]
[TideXcell]

## Imagining Tide from a 360 perspective is now ready for viewing!

With iTide, our newest and latest bioreactors in the pipeline are perfectly curated to provide
real-time user experience. One can see how the Tide Motion works for every system, its culture
features, footprint, and many more.

Let your eyes take in a visual representation of both bench-scale and closed, automated
manufacturing scale bioreactor system for cell culture with just the tip of your cursor.

[The Other Tide  ][11]
WHO WE ARE

Esco Healthcare is a division of Esco LifeSciences group that provides bioprocess solutions. We
market bioprocessing tools such as bioreactors for both adherent and suspension culture, harvesting
systems for a closed, automated product harvest, and more.

[Learn More About Us  ][12]

# Esco Healthcare
# Product Portfolio

The Esco Healthcare has a wide range of bioprocess solutions from adherent bioreactors, stirred tank
bioreactors, consumables, cell-line specific culture medium, and more. Bioprocess manufacturing
includes several key components to improve product yield. As part of the bioprocess equipment
manufacturers worldwide, our systems are perfect for research and development up to commercial or
manufacturing scale.

CelCradle

CelCradle is a bench-scale bioreactor system that can support high adherent cell density culture. It
is a single-use, cost effective packed-bed bioreactor system for adherent scale-up from laboratory
scale to production scale. This disposable bioreactor fits inside a 6ft³ CO2 incubator (for batch
culture) or 8.5ft³ CO2 incubator (for perfusion culture).

The ready-to-use bottles, as part of single-use manufacturing, helps eliminate validation costs as
compared to multiple-use system when starting on your next cell culture run. The system components
come pre-sterilized, pre-packed that speed up your research whether for vaccine, stem cell, or viral
production applications.

[Learn More ][9]
[CelCradle]

TideXcell

TideXcell^{®} is a linearly scalable pilot bioreactor system that runs on Tide Motion principle. It
is ideal for biomass expansion of adherent cells under single-use or multiple-use technologies. The
pilot scale bioreactor is also integrated with desirable and advanced features such as pH and DO
(Dissolved Oxygen) measurement capability, Siemens HMI or PLC-based monitoring and control system,
compressed air path that comes with a double HEPA and VOC (volatile organic chemicals) filters as
well as other accessories.
[Learn More ][10]
[TideXcell]

With iTide, our newest and latest bioreactors in the pipeline are perfectly curated to provide
real-time user experience. One can see how the Tide Motion works for every system, its culture
features, footprint, and many more.

Let your eyes take in a visual representation of both bench-scale and closed, automated
manufacturing scale bioreactor system for cell culture with just the tip of your cursor.

* # Foreign Trade Online
  
  Welcome to the world largest international B2B trade and supply chain community
  * One-Stop destination for international trade
  * Expand your business globally
  * Discover new sales leads
  * Access to vast import and export resources
* # Endless Business Opportunities
  
  Access to network of industry professionals - open new markets and business opportunities. Free
  access to:
  * Importers & buyers
  * Market research tools
  * Sales lead generation
  * Industry solutions and more
* # Discovery to Delivery
  
  A vibrant global community for Buyers, Suppliers, Inspectors, Freight Forwarders, Customs Brokers,
  Insurance Brokers, Finance Brokers, Trade Show Organizers, trade professionals and institutions -
  facilitating the global trade, from discovery to delivery and beyond, reducing cost and adding
  value.
* # Worldwide Sourcing
  
  Whether you are a small business owner, SME buyer or corporation, you can source from worldwide
  suppliers across all industries and also find qualified:
  * Inspectors
  * Logistic providers
  * Customs brokers
  * Warehouse and more

## GMPTEC

The GMPTEC product portfolio includes a huge variety of components and systems for the production of
pharmaceuticals, also diagnostics, chemical products and high-quality foods. Most of the GMPTEC
technologies are being used in the biotechnology and both, our [**single-use**][42] and multi-use
components, are suitable for cGMP conform biotech-applications. GMPTECs primary goal is to cover all
requirements out of one source! This does not only include a huge range of different products, but
also services like consulting, assessment and troubleshooting, as well as development and
construction.

In terms of customized assemblies, we will gladly take care of the whole product development
process! From the first draft, to a technical drawing, to a competitive offer – completely free of
charge! Our **[cleanroom services][43]** allow us to create another added value for your processes!
We do not only deliver off-the-shelf products in big standardized packaging units: To meet your
individual requirements we can clean single GMPTEC goods, channel them into the ISO class 7
cleanroom, also label or laser engrave them, repackage them individually and deliver them directly
to you. Right from the start, we make your solutions and interests to our first priority!

We are always available by phone or e-mail and willing to schedule meetings on site even at short
notice. The core competence of our team is their wide technical knowledge about the production
technologies on the market. We do not settle for only few key products. Instead we want to offer
seamless solutions, even if it should be beyond our own portfolio.

#### [Single-use and Multi-use Technologies][44]

Due to their variety and overall quality, GMPTEC products can be used in clinical studies, pilot
plants and valid GMP productions. Material certificates, validation reports and extensive
extractable and leachable studies are common standard for our products. Hardcopies of batch-related
certificates, for example FDA CFR 177.1520, USP Class VI <88> and BSE/TSE, will be shipped together
with the product. If you wish, we will gladly also send a digital copy of the certificates via
e-mail.

Regardless, whether your production is based on single-use or CIP/SIP **[technologies][45]**, you
will find the right tubing or tubing set for your system. Within GMPTECs product range, you can even
find adaptions from single-use to multi-use or the other way round. We are looking forward to work
out a solution together and according to your individual situation.

related to the food-, cosmetic- and pharmaceutical industry. Detailed information about GMP can be
found on **[Wikipedia][47]**. The quintessence of GMP is the observance and securing of process- and
product quality, as well as governmental regulations.

## GMPTEC

The GMPTEC product portfolio includes a huge variety of components and systems for the production of
pharmaceuticals, also diagnostics, chemical products and high-quality foods. Most of the GMPTEC
technologies are being used in the biotechnology and both, our [**single-use**][42] and multi-use
components, are suitable for cGMP conform biotech-applications. GMPTECs primary goal is to cover all
requirements out of one source! This does not only include a huge range of different products, but
also services like consulting, assessment and troubleshooting, as well as development and
construction.

In terms of customized assemblies, we will gladly take care of the whole product development
process! From the first draft, to a technical drawing, to a competitive offer – completely free of
charge! Our **[cleanroom services][43]** allow us to create another added value for your processes!
We do not only deliver off-the-shelf products in big standardized packaging units: To meet your
individual requirements we can clean single GMPTEC goods, channel them into the ISO class 7
cleanroom, also label or laser engrave them, repackage them individually and deliver them directly
to you. Right from the start, we make your solutions and interests to our first priority!

We are always available by phone or e-mail and willing to schedule meetings on site even at short
notice. The core competence of our team is their wide technical knowledge about the production
technologies on the market. We do not settle for only few key products. Instead we want to offer
seamless solutions, even if it should be beyond our own portfolio.

#### [Single-use and Multi-use Technologies][44]

Due to their variety and overall quality, GMPTEC products can be used in clinical studies, pilot
plants and valid GMP productions. Material certificates, validation reports and extensive
extractable and leachable studies are common standard for our products. Hardcopies of batch-related
certificates, for example FDA CFR 177.1520, USP Class VI <88> and BSE/TSE, will be shipped together
with the product. If you wish, we will gladly also send a digital copy of the certificates via
e-mail.

Regardless, whether your production is based on single-use or CIP/SIP **[technologies][45]**, you
will find the right tubing or tubing set for your system. Within GMPTECs product range, you can even
find adaptions from single-use to multi-use or the other way round. We are looking forward to work
out a solution together and according to your individual situation.

# Leading the Way in Peptide & Protein Purification Precision

Facilitating advanced peptide and protein purification through intelligent and efficient workflows
that enhance quality and foster innovation.

## Who we are

Intech Analytical Instruments, trusted supplier of synthesis and chromatography solutions, offers
precise technologies for use in research, industry, and medicine. We collaborate with Hanbon, a
world leader in preparative HPLC manufacturers and liquid chromatography, to achieve the highest
international standards by fusing advanced technology with top-notch engineering.

Designed for scalability, reproducibility, and uncompromising purity, our portfolio includes
Preparative HPLC systems and columns, chromatography media (silica), LPLC systems, glass columns,
TFF systems, inline buffer dilution systems, oligonucleotide synthesizers, Peptide Synthesis
Machine, and analytical columns. These systems, which combine scientific accuracy with industrial
dependability, are designed for both research and large-scale manufacturing.

With a focus on turnkey projects and customized end-to-end solutions, we offer full support, from

User manuals are traditionally provided in a PDF format, but this format is difficult to use on a
mobile device. ManualsPro transcribes many of these PDF documents into regular web-pages so that
users can better read them on their device of choice. This makes many documents more screen-reader
accessible and searchable vs the traditional format. You will also find a link to the original PDF
file within each post - these can be downloaded for later and opened with your favorite web-browser
or PDF viewer such as Adobe Acrobat.

ManualsPro makes reading user manuals easier!

# What to Expect:

## Transparency, Partnership, Peace of Mind

[Preloader image]

### **Risk Reduction**

Our primary commitment is a reduction in risk for our clients’ processes, and ultimately, the
patients who use their products. We understand that the products and services we provide have an
immediately tangible impact on the human condition.

### **Automation**

Automation encompasses all of our processes, not just production equipment. We use automation to
reduce risk for our clients while also increasing their operational efficiency. Automated systems
provide error-proofing and are refined until all sources of variability are removed.

### **Vertical Integration**

Vertical integration allows us to provide an exceedingly robust supply chain and augmented quality
control while at the same time facilitating enhanced material traceability and transparency.

### **Quality**

Our products and systems cannot and do not fail. Right products, to specification, every time, on
time. Quality is not a silo at Meissner, it’s an elementary commitment, a critical component of our
organization that drives continuous improvement.

### **Customer Experience**

The traditional vendor-customer paradigm does not apply to the space in which we interact with our
clients. We establish open communication with our clients at multiple levels within the
organization, creating cross-functional teams and a long-term partnership.

### **Specialization**

We are the best in class at what we do and won’t provide a commodity for the sole purpose of
rounding out a portfolio. This industry values expertise, and in those areas in which we specialize,
we deliver.

### **Scientific Expertise**

We understand and expand the science behind our products and apply it early to your process. Our
clients rely on us for this knowledge, and we continuously focus on enhancing our capabilities,
knowledge base, and the level of support we provide.

### **Engineering Acumen**

We provide “Personalized Engineering.” The solutions our engineering teams develop for your process
are customized for your specific needs. They use fundamental building blocks based on our
well-established engineering design space and leverage our knowledge base pertaining to best
practices.

# What to Expect:

## Transparency, Partnership, Peace of Mind

[Preloader image]

### **Risk Reduction**

Our primary commitment is a reduction in risk for our clients’ processes, and ultimately, the
patients who use their products. We understand that the products and services we provide have an
immediately tangible impact on the human condition.

### **Automation**

Automation encompasses all of our processes, not just production equipment. We use automation to
reduce risk for our clients while also increasing their operational efficiency. Automated systems
provide error-proofing and are refined until all sources of variability are removed.

### **Vertical Integration**

Vertical integration allows us to provide an exceedingly robust supply chain and augmented quality
control while at the same time facilitating enhanced material traceability and transparency.

### **Quality**

Our products and systems cannot and do not fail. Right products, to specification, every time, on
time. Quality is not a silo at Meissner, it’s an elementary commitment, a critical component of our
organization that drives continuous improvement.

### **Customer Experience**

The traditional vendor-customer paradigm does not apply to the space in which we interact with our
clients. We establish open communication with our clients at multiple levels within the
organization, creating cross-functional teams and a long-term partnership.

### **Specialization**

We are the best in class at what we do and won’t provide a commodity for the sole purpose of
rounding out a portfolio. This industry values expertise, and in those areas in which we specialize,
we deliver.

### **Scientific Expertise**

We understand and expand the science behind our products and apply it early to your process. Our
clients rely on us for this knowledge, and we continuously focus on enhancing our capabilities,
knowledge base, and the level of support we provide.

### **Engineering Acumen**

We provide “Personalized Engineering.” The solutions our engineering teams develop for your process
are customized for your specific needs. They use fundamental building blocks based on our
well-established engineering design space and leverage our knowledge base pertaining to best
practices.

### 考えるだけで自分の手が動き、その手で「触れた」と感じる——完全麻痺の脊髄損傷に挑む「二重神経バイパ
### ス」

首から下が完全に麻痺した男性が、考えるだけで自分の手を動かし、握った物の感触も感じられるようになりま
した。米ファインスタイン医学研究所のチームは、脳と脊髄・大脳皮質を同時に橋渡しする「二重神経バイパス
（DNB）」を開発。装置がオンの間は手の運動と触覚を肩代わりし（アシスト）、電気刺激による訓練で装置を
切ってもなお残る回復（治療）まで引き出しました。卵の殻を割らずに掴み、自分で食事し、麻痺していた手首
で犬の毛の感触を再び感じた——この画期的な first-in-human 研究をエクソ太郎が読み解きます。
解説を読む →
][19][
細胞外小胞
2026-07-20

### 肥満で酷使される膵臓は、そばの幹細胞に「応援」を求めていた——β細胞が放つmiR-151小胞が、間葉系幹細
### 胞を「助っ人」に変える

肥満が続くと膵臓のβ細胞は数を増やし働きを高めて糖尿病を食い止めます（β細胞代償）。中国薬科大学などの
チームは、この非常時にβ細胞がmiR-151を積んだ細胞外小胞（sEV）を放ち、隣の間葉系幹細胞（MSC）を「助っ
人」に変えることを示しました。MSCはKLF9のブレーキを外されて増殖しWNTを分泌し、β細胞を支えます。細胞
とマウスの前臨床研究をエクソ太郎が読み解きます。
解説を読む →
][20][
MSCエクソソーム
2026-07-19

### 老いた肝臓の「掃除機能」を呼び戻す——臍帯幹細胞エクソソームが運ぶTHBS1が、脂肪をため込む肝臓を作
### り替える

年を重ねると、肝臓は静かに脂肪をため込みます。その裏側では、細胞の掃除機能『オートファジー』が錆びつ
いている。中国・山東大学斉魯病院のチームは、ヒト臍帯由来の間葉系幹細胞（HucMSC）が放つエクソソームが
、積荷タンパク質THBS1を鍵として、またPPARシグナルを下流経路として、老いたマウスの肝臓の脂肪蓄積・老
化・糖代謝を改善することを示しました。前臨床研究をエクソ太郎が読み解きます。
解説を読む →
][21][
脳科学
2026-07-12

### 「筋肉」と「脳」をつなぎ直す——運動で神経疾患の認知を取り戻す鍵『認知運動統合（CMI）』

運動は末梢のBDNF・乳酸・免疫や血管のシグナルを介して脳にも働きかける。しかし『バイオマーカーが動いた
』だけでは認知は戻らない。イタリアの神経リハビリ研究チームは、運動の生物学的効果が“注意を要する動作”
と結びつき、認知運動統合（CMI）という行動として現れて初めて臨床的な意味を持つ、という統合モデルを提
示。脳卒中・パーキンソン病・多発性硬化症・外傷性脳損傷ごとの違いと、VR・ロボット・ウェアラブルの活か
し方までを見渡す総説を、エクソ太郎が読み解く。
解説を読む →
][22][
MSCエクソソーム
2026-07-12

### パーキンソン病の「暴走する脳の免疫」に挑む——鼻の奥の幹細胞エクソソームが運ぶlncRNAが、ミクログリ
### アの糖代謝を組み替える

パーキンソン病では、脳の免疫細胞ミクログリアが「糖をがぶ飲みする戦闘モード」に切り替わり、炎症で神経
を傷つけます。中国・海口の研究チームは、鼻の奥の粘膜からとれる間葉系幹細胞（OM-MSC）のエクソソームが
運ぶ長鎖ノンコーディングRNA『lncA2M-AS1』が、CFL1/ROCK1という2つのスイッチを介してミクログリアの代謝
を鎮め、神経炎症を抑えることを示しました。マウスと培養細胞での前臨床研究を、エクソ太郎が読み解きます
。

We enter into contracts with companies every day. Each of those contracts was with something with

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our

## It shouldn't be hard to get legal-entity data you can trust

And yet it is. Legal-entity information is dispersed across hundreds of business registers that are
hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no

Verifiable accuracy is more important than ever, and you should expect more.

You need data built on deep expertise, rigorous data models and [well-founded, forward-looking

hidden bias, and defined by open not proprietary identifiers and standards. Data you know you can
trust.

## OpenCorporates was born out of the same frustrations you experience every day

We believe a fairer, more prosperous and sustainable society can only be achieved with greater
corporate transparency.

Since 2010 we’ve been working with government agencies, NGOs and public-benefit groups to improve
the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

Today we offer the world's largest open legal-entity database, providing a single unified set of 
company records from over 140 government registries and other official sources around the world.

news, and more.

company status.

### Tratamiento térmico de fluidos: pasteurización del hidrolizado de clara de huevo

Línea automatizada para la producción de hidrolizado de clara de huevo, optimizando las curvas
térmicas para preservar la integridad proteica.

Leer

[
30/04/2026

### Reutilización de aguas industriales mediante tecnologías de filtración para la producción de
### hidrógeno verde

La producción de hidrógeno verde a partir de residuos agroalimentarios requiere algo más que
electrólisis: exige control de la calidad del agua. Este artículo analiza el papel de la filtración
tangencial por membranas como tecnología habilitadora en sistemas integrados de tratamiento y
generación de hidrógeno en el marco del proyecto VALHAGRO.

Leer
][107]
[
25/03/2026

### Recuperación de agua en procesos industriales mediante un sistema polisher basado en filtración
### tangencial por membranas.

En un proyecto desarrollado en Argentina, se implementó un sistema polisher basado en tecnologías de
membranas, capaz de recuperar agua de permeados complejos y optimizar el consumo hídrico en procesos
industriales.

Leer
][108]
[
11/03/2026

### Valorización de líquidos industriales mediante filtración por membranas.

La filtración por membranas permite la valorización de líquidos industriales y la recuperación de
agua en procesos de concentración de plasma animal, mejorando la eficiencia hídrica y energética.

Leer
][109]
[
25/02/2026

### Filtración de plasma sanguíneo animal: concentración industrial de fluidos biológicos de alto
### valor

Perinox desarrolló una instalación industrial para la filtración y concentración de plasma sanguíneo
animal destinada a una multinacional del sector de plasma atomizado. El proyecto integró tratamiento
de fluidos biológicos, sistema CIP, automatización SCADA y control sanitario para garantizar
trazabilidad, eficiencia operativa y estabilidad en un proceso de alto valor añadido.

Leer
][110]
[
03/02/2026

### Biotecnología plant-based: tratamiento de fluidos y escalado industrial con filtración
### tangencial

Perinox desarrolló una línea de tratamiento de fluidos para biotecnología plant-based orientada al
procesamiento de ingredientes bioactivos de origen vegetal. El proyecto integró fermentación,
filtración, pasteurización, llenado, automatización y sistema CIP para garantizar control,
eficiencia y escalabilidad industrial.

Leer
][111]
[
23/01/2026

### Sistema de recuperación de agua industrial desarrollado por Perinox en una planta de zumos

Perinox desarrolla un sistema de recuperación de agua industrial y solución alcalina en una planta
de zumos, actuando sobre la limpieza de columnas de intercambio iónico. El proyecto permite
reutilizar recursos dentro del ciclo productivo, reducir costes operativos y avanzar hacia procesos
alimentarios más eficientes y sostenibles.

Leer

internacional**, con el objetivo de optimizar la producción de **queso fresco** mediante la
integración de **tecnología de Ultrafiltración (UF)** y un alto grado de **automatización del
proceso**.

## WELCOME TO SANITECH ENGINEERS

### A Customized Membrane Filtration, and Preparative Chromatography Systems Manufacturer

Sanitech Engineers specializes in the design and manufacture of membrane systems and preparative
chromatography systems for a variety of sectors, including Pharmaceutical, BioPharmaceutical,
Nutraceutical, Dairy and Food & Beverages. Our engineering and project management team continuously
strive to make new innovative technological concepts into a reality

Our R&D and process engineering teams assist our clients in moving novel separation and purification
solutions from the lab to manufacturing. All of our advanced equipment are created in our
cutting-edge production facilities and exceed the most stringent governmental guidelines. We have
service teams situated throughout India and overseas that give exceptional after-sales support to
our big pool of happy clients.

#### INTELLIGENT INFRASTRUCTURE FOR SCIENCE

# Life Sciences R&D Moves Faster Without the Friction.

When the operational friction disappears, science moves at the speed of discovery: not the speed of
the process around it. Science Exchange's intelligent infrastructure is how life sciences
organizations get there.

[ Request a Demo ][71]

## Trusted by industry visionaries

[logo-amgen]
[logo-merck]
[GILEAD - Logo]
[INCYTE - Logo]
[Karuna - Logo]
[Furclum - Logo]

#### THE PROBLEM

## Science has advanced.
## Its infrastructure has not.

Life sciences organizations are advancing faster than ever: new modalities, distributed research
models, and increasingly specialized partners. But the systems supporting that work remain
fragmented.

Finding qualified research partners takes weeks. Contracts require months of negotiation. Onboarding
a new provider means starting a process that, on average, consumes more than 50 hours before any
work begins. The problem isn't the people managing it. It's that the infrastructure around R&D was
built for a different era. Generic procurement tools, siloed contracting processes, and fragmented
payment workflows were not designed for the speed and compliance requirements of life sciences
research.

When programs run behind, the cost is measured in delayed outcomes, missed opportunities, and time
that can't be recovered.

[ Discover our solutions ][72]
[media-1]

#### WHAT SCIENCE EXCHANGE DOES

## One Platform.
## Every Research Relationship.

Science Exchange centralizes R&D research operations: sourcing qualified partners, executing
contracts, managing compliance, and processing payments, all under one platform and one master
service agreement covering thousands of pre-vetted providers.

What used to take 50 hours now takes 6. That reduction is not a projection. It is what organizations
running on Science Exchange experience.

[ See the Platform ][73]
[overview-plat-architecture-1]

#### WHO IT'S FOR

## Built for Everyone Who Touches R&D Operations

Scientists and R&D Leaders
Access qualified research partners without the procurement overhead. Start projects sooner.

[ Learn More ][74]

Standardized processes, pre-negotiated frameworks, and visibility across every active research
relationship.

[ Learn More ][75]

Compliance built in. Unified contract structure. Audit-ready documentation on every engagement.

[ Learn More ][76]

Operations and Quality
Onboarding automation, spend visibility, and consistent process across the entire research
portfolio.

[ Learn More ][77]

## The organizations setting the standard for life sciences R&D run on Science Exchange.

#### TESTIMONIALS

[quote icon]

Science Exchange has helped us to accelerate our R&D programs and rapidly advance candidates. It’s a
transformative platform.

Christopher Moxham, Ph.D.

Chief Scientific Officer, Fulcrum Therapeutics

These teams operate in highly regulated environments with complex research portfolios. They chose
Science Exchange because the platform was built for this work specifically, not adapted from a
general procurement tool.

[ Read our Case Studies ][78]

## The mission is science. Not administration

Every hour a scientist spends navigating procurement is an hour a program doesn't move forward.
Science Exchange removes that friction: not by making the current process faster, but by replacing
what was never fit for purpose in the first place.

#### INTELLIGENT INFRASTRUCTURE FOR SCIENCE

# Life Sciences R&D Moves Faster Without the Friction.

When the operational friction disappears, science moves at the speed of discovery: not the speed of
the process around it. Science Exchange's intelligent infrastructure is how life sciences
organizations get there.

[ Request a Demo ][71]

## Trusted by industry visionaries

[logo-amgen]
[logo-merck]
[GILEAD - Logo]
[INCYTE - Logo]
[Karuna - Logo]
[Furclum - Logo]

#### THE PROBLEM

## Science has advanced.
## Its infrastructure has not.

Life sciences organizations are advancing faster than ever: new modalities, distributed research
models, and increasingly specialized partners. But the systems supporting that work remain
fragmented.

Finding qualified research partners takes weeks. Contracts require months of negotiation. Onboarding
a new provider means starting a process that, on average, consumes more than 50 hours before any
work begins. The problem isn't the people managing it. It's that the infrastructure around R&D was
built for a different era. Generic procurement tools, siloed contracting processes, and fragmented
payment workflows were not designed for the speed and compliance requirements of life sciences
research.

When programs run behind, the cost is measured in delayed outcomes, missed opportunities, and time
that can't be recovered.

[ Discover our solutions ][72]
[media-1]

#### WHAT SCIENCE EXCHANGE DOES

## One Platform.
## Every Research Relationship.

Science Exchange centralizes R&D research operations: sourcing qualified partners, executing
contracts, managing compliance, and processing payments, all under one platform and one master
service agreement covering thousands of pre-vetted providers.

What used to take 50 hours now takes 6. That reduction is not a projection. It is what organizations
running on Science Exchange experience.

[ See the Platform ][73]
[overview-plat-architecture-1]

#### WHO IT'S FOR

## Built for Everyone Who Touches R&D Operations

[scientist_rd_leaders]

[procurement]

Procurement Teams

relationship.

[ Learn More ][75]
[finance_legal]

Finance and Legal
Compliance built in. Unified contract structure. Audit-ready documentation on every engagement.

[ Learn More ][76]
[operations_quality]

Operations and Quality
Onboarding automation, spend visibility, and consistent process across the entire research
portfolio.

[ Learn More ][77]

## The organizations setting the standard for life sciences R&D run on Science Exchange.

#### TESTIMONIALS

[quote icon]

Science Exchange has helped us to accelerate our R&D programs and rapidly advance candidates. It’s a
transformative platform.

Christopher Moxham, Ph.D.

Chief Scientific Officer, Fulcrum Therapeutics

These teams operate in highly regulated environments with complex research portfolios. They chose
Science Exchange because the platform was built for this work specifically, not adapted from a
general procurement tool.

[ Read our Case Studies ][78]

## The mission is science. Not administration

Every hour a scientist spends navigating procurement is an hour a program doesn't move forward.
Science Exchange removes that friction: not by making the current process faster, but by replacing
what was never fit for purpose in the first place.

# Smart Biotech Solutions to scale from lab to production with confidence.

## [Bioreactor Solutions][111]

### [from 0.5 to 2000L][112]

[Bioreactors][113]

## [Tangential Flow Filtration Solutions][114]

### [from 0.1 m² to 65 m² ][115]

[Tangential Flow Filtration][116]

## [Supplies][117]

### [Single Use Bags | Flowkits | Vessels][118]

[Supplies][119]

## Lab-scale solutions for Bioprocessing

Single-use & multi-use Bioreactors and TFF systems for lab-scale processes. Suitable for mAbs,
vaccines, recombinant proteins, and cell & gene therapy. Volumes up to 10 L | Membrane area up to
0.7 m².

[Lab-scale solutions][120]
**eLAB TFF Single-Use**
Compact TFF system designed for lab-scale concentration and diafiltration processes. Single-use flow
path ensures quick setup and easy cleaning.

**Membrane area:** up to 0.7 m²
**eLAB Essential**
Compact and easy-to-use bioreactor designed for academic research and early-stage development. Ideal
for microbial and cell culture processes at lab scale.

**Volumes:** 0.3 to 5 L
**eLAB TFF**
Multi-use TFF system for lab-scale concentration, diafiltration, and clarification. Compatible with
cassette, hollow fiber, and ceramic membranes.

**Membrane area:** up to 0.7 m²

## Pilot-scale solutions for Bioprocessing

Single-use & multi-use TFF systems, Bioreactors, and supplies for process development and scale-up.
Designed for mAbs, vaccines, and recombinant protein production. Volumes up to 50 L | Membrane area
up to 2.5 m².

[Pilot-scale solutions][121]
**ePilot Bioreactor SU**
Dual-use single-use bioreactor for pilot-scale applications. Suitable for both microbial and cell
culture processes, combining flexibility and scalability with reduced cleaning needs.

**Volumes:** 30 to 50 L
**ePLUS SU Mixer**
Single-use mixing system for media and buffer preparation. Designed for fast setup, efficient
mixing, and reduced cleaning time.

**Volumes:** 50 to 500 L
**eBAG 3D Mixer**
Single-use 3D mixing bag for efficient homogenization of media and buffers. Designed for closed
systems with bottom magnetic stirring and top handle for easy handling.

**Volumes:** 50 to 500 L
**ePilot Bioreactor MU**
Multi-use bioreactor for pilot-scale microbial and cell culture processes. Designed for process
development and scale-up with full automation and control.

**Volumes:** 30 to 50 L
**ePLUS CIP**
Automated Clean-in-Place system designed for cleaning tanks, bioreactors, and process lines. Ensures
consistent cleaning performance with customizable recipes.

**Volumes:** up to 2,000L
**ePilot TFF MU**
Multi-use TFF system for pilot-scale concentration, clarification, and diafiltration. Compatible
with cassette, hollow fiber, and ceramic membranes.

**Membrane area:** up to 2.5 m²
**eBAG 3D STR**
Single-use 3D bag designed for stirred-tank bioreactors. Optimized for cell culture processes with
bottom magnetic stirring and secure top ports.

**Volumes:** 50 to 1000L

## Production-scale solutions for Bioprocessing

Single & multi-use Bioreactors, TFF systems and process supplies for large-scale bioproduction. For
mAbs, vaccines, recombinant proteins. Volumes up to 2000 L | Membrane area up to 65 m².

[Production-scale solutions][122]
**eProd Bioreactor SU**
Single-use bioreactor for large-scale microbial and cell culture processes. Designed for commercial
manufacturing with advanced control and scalable configuration.

**Volumes:** up to 4,000 L
**eProd TFF**
Multi-use TFF system for large-scale concentration, clarification, and diafiltration. Compatible
with cassette, hollow fiber, and ceramic membranes.

**Membrane area:** up to 65 m²
**eProd Bioreactor MU**
Multi-use bioreactor for large-scale bioproduction. Designed for microbial and cell culture
processes with stainless steel vessels and integrated control systems.

**Volumes:** up to 2000 L
**eBAG 3D STR**
Single-use 3D bag designed for stirred-tank bioreactors. Optimized for cell culture applications
with bottom magnetic stirring and top ports for secure integration.

**Volumes:** 30 to 1000 L
**ePLUS SU Mixer**
Single-use mixing system for media preparation and buffer formulation. Ensures fast setup, easy
operation, and reliable mixing performance.

**Volumes:** 50 to 500 L
**ePLUS CIP**
Automated Clean-in-Place system designed for cleaning tanks, bioreactors, and process lines. Ensures
consistent cleaning performance with customizable recipes.

**Volumes:** up to 2,000L

## Accelerate Your Development with YMC Insight Centers

Leverage the expertise of our state-of-the-art laboratories and highly skilled scientists to bring
your product development goals to life. Our comprehensive services include scale-down and scale-up
methods, impurity amplification, continuous purification, column screening, method development and
troubleshooting, and much more.

You’ll find our Insight Center labs in the Americas, Europe, Japan, and India. Whether you’re
working with small or large molecules, batch or continuous processes, we have the solutions you
need.

[Learn More][96]

CEO Mark Dyment introduces the viewer to a brief virtual tour of one Insight Center Lab facility and

## Latest News

Stay informed with the latest industry insights and exciting product and service announcements from
YMC

[See all articles][97]

July 16, 2026

### Making Peptide Purification Green without Forfeiting Productivity.

While green solvents like ethanol and DMC are better for the planet, they typically suffer from
lower chromatographic resolution in traditional setups. This has resulted in a trade-off of choosing
sustainability, or choosing high yield. The whitepaper Counter-Current Chromatography Enables Use of
Green Solvents for Productive Peptide Purification Processes shows how using Multi-column
Counter-current Solvent Gradient Purification (MCSGP) can overcome the inefficiencies of
eco-friendly mobile phases.
[Read More][99]

July 8, 2026

### Optimizing Liquid Chromatography for Vitamin Analysis

Vitamins play a critical role in human health, serving as precursors to vital coenzymes, supporting
metabolic pathways, and offering widespread benefits across the pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, and
cosmetic industries. However, analyzing water-soluble vitamins such as the B-complex group and
Vitamin C, presents unique challenges for analytical chemists.
[Read More][100]

June 18, 2026

### Happy Retirement, John!

Today, we are celebrating John Heffernan, who is officially stepping into retirement after 16 years
with YMC America. John’s journey with us actually began back when we were known as Integrated
Process Technologies, long before we transitioned to YMC America. Over the years, John has worn many
hats, from Project Manager to Estimating Manager, Engineering Manager, and ultimately Director of
Business Development.
[Read More][101]

June 2, 2026

### Chromatography of Biotherapeuticals – Analyzing and Purifying Peptides and Oligonucleotides

This webinar will highlight how advanced ultra-high-performance liquid chromatography (UHPLC)
strategies, carefully selected stationary phases, and bioinert hardware can significantly improve
the analysis and purification of peptides and oligonucleotides.
[Read More][102]

May 21, 2026

### Breaking Down mRNA Capping Efficiency with High-Resolution IP-RP LC

Evaluating 5' capping efficiency is a critical quality attribute in therapeutic mRNA manufacturing,
directly impacting translation efficiency and transcript stability. However, separating structurally
similar capped, partially capped, and uncapped species differing by just a single nucleotide remains
a significant chromatographic challenge.
[Read More][103]

## Latest News

Stay informed with the latest industry insights and exciting product and service announcements from
YMC

[See all articles][97]
[Join Our Mailing List][98]

July 16, 2026

### Making Peptide Purification Green without Forfeiting Productivity.

While green solvents like ethanol and DMC are better for the planet, they typically suffer from
lower chromatographic resolution in traditional setups. This has resulted in a trade-off of choosing
sustainability, or choosing high yield. The whitepaper Counter-Current Chromatography Enables Use of
Green Solvents for Productive Peptide Purification Processes shows how using Multi-column
Counter-current Solvent Gradient Purification (MCSGP) can overcome the inefficiencies of
eco-friendly mobile phases.
[Read More][99]

July 8, 2026

### Optimizing Liquid Chromatography for Vitamin Analysis

Vitamins play a critical role in human health, serving as precursors to vital coenzymes, supporting
metabolic pathways, and offering widespread benefits across the pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, and
cosmetic industries. However, analyzing water-soluble vitamins such as the B-complex group and
Vitamin C, presents unique challenges for analytical chemists.
[Read More][100]

June 18, 2026

### Happy Retirement, John!

Today, we are celebrating John Heffernan, who is officially stepping into retirement after 16 years
with YMC America. John’s journey with us actually began back when we were known as Integrated
Process Technologies, long before we transitioned to YMC America. Over the years, John has worn many
hats, from Project Manager to Estimating Manager, Engineering Manager, and ultimately Director of
Business Development.
[Read More][101]

June 2, 2026

### Chromatography of Biotherapeuticals – Analyzing and Purifying Peptides and Oligonucleotides

This webinar will highlight how advanced ultra-high-performance liquid chromatography (UHPLC)
strategies, carefully selected stationary phases, and bioinert hardware can significantly improve
the analysis and purification of peptides and oligonucleotides.
[Read More][102]

May 21, 2026

### Breaking Down mRNA Capping Efficiency with High-Resolution IP-RP LC

Evaluating 5' capping efficiency is a critical quality attribute in therapeutic mRNA manufacturing,
directly impacting translation efficiency and transcript stability. However, separating structurally
similar capped, partially capped, and uncapped species differing by just a single nucleotide remains
a significant chromatographic challenge.
[Read More][103]
